## Problem statement

A clear and concise description of the problem this feature would solve.
Example: "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed solution

Describe the solution you'd like. Be as specific as possible — include API
changes, new config variables, or architectural notes if relevant.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered and why you
ruled them out.

## Additional context

Add any other context, mockups, or references here (e.g. links to similar
implementations, relevant papers, upstream library issues).
